headline_marked: PM visits [[police officers injured while chasing muggers]] in Adabari
headline: PM visits police officers injured while chasing muggers in Adabari
summary: Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina visited the injured officers to offer support and encourage them during their recovery.
details: The Prime Minister visited police officers who were injured during an operation to capture muggers in Adabari.
During the visit, she expressed her support for the officers' bravery and commitment to maintaining law and order.
The Prime Minister inquired about their health status and provided encouragement to their families.
The officers are currently receiving medical treatment and are recovering from their injuries sustained during the duty.
The visit highlights the government's government's commitment to ensuring the security of citizens and the officers' sacrifices in the fight against crime.

headline_marked: Remittance flow rises: [[$1.72 billion sent to Bangladesh]] in first 16 days of June
headline: Remittance flow rises: $1.72 billion sent to Bangladesh in first 16 days of June
summary: Daily average remittance has reached approximately $108.1 million, showing an increase compared to the same period last year.
details: Bangladesh received $1.729 billion in remittances during the first 16 days of June, according to Bangladesh Bank spokesperson Arif Hossain Khan.
caption:
Bangladesh received $1.729 billion in remittances in just 16 days of June, averaging $108.1 million per day.

Bangladesh received $1.729 billion in remittances during the first 16 days of June, according to Bangladesh Bank spokesperson Arif Hossain Khan.
